summary:
### Goal
Fix currency rounding in `ledgerly/money.py` so JPY amounts do not use two decimal places. PDF async migration is paused.

### Constraints and rules
Keep commits small and separate; rebase onto `origin/main`, then squash when ready. Never edit `ledgerly/migrations/` before pinging @dana-db in `#prod-db-changes`. Staging is `db-stg-2.internal`. Do not continue webhook cutover unless instructed. Paste exact test output next time rather than paraphrasing.

### Key decisions and facts
`build_invoice_lines` now returns `list(_iter_line_items(...))` to satisfy mypy. `calculate_totals` converts discounts with `Decimal(str(discount))`. Ledger timestamps now use timezone-aware `datetime.now(timezone.utc)`.

### Ruled out
PDF export migration. Tenant indexing was not the search bottleneck; per-invoice embeddings were.

### Progress
CSV UTF-8 fix and regression coverage remain ready for a separate commit. Billing typing/rounding-adjacent changes touched three files. `python -m pytest tests/billing -q` passed 34 tests; deprecated `utcnow()` warning was removed. `git diff --check` passed.

### Next steps
Inspect current `money.py` and tests, implement currency-aware JPY quantization, add regression coverage, and paste exact pytest/mypy/ruff output.
